# Haraka

## Documentation Sets

- [Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/llms-full.txt)

## Docs

Every page below is available as raw markdown.

- [About](https://haraka.github.io/raw/about.md): These pages attempt to give a potted history of Haraka.
- [Bare Line Feeds sent to Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/raw/barelf.md): Bare Line Feeds sent to Haraka
- [Community](https://haraka.github.io/raw/community.md): Haraka has a strong community presence. Use the links below to talk with us.
- [Address Object](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Address.md): The Address object is an interface to reading email addresses passed in at
SMTP time. As such it parses all the formats in RFC-2821 and 2822, and
supports correctly escaping email addresses.
- [Body Object](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Body.md): This documentation has moved to haraka/email-message.
- [Config](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Config.md): This documentation has moved to haraka-config.
- [Connection Object](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Connection.md): For each connection to Haraka there is one connection object.
- [Core Configuration Files](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/CoreConfig.md): See Logging.
- [Custom Return Codes](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/CustomReturnCodes.md): This content has moved to haraka-dsn.
- [HAProxy PROXY protocol extension support](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/HAProxy.md): Haraka natively supports the PROXY protocol 1.
- [Header Object](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Header.md): This documentation has moved to haraka/email-message.
- [Logging](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Logging.md): Haraka has built-in logging (see API docs below) and support for log plugins.
- [Logging API](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Logging_API.md): Logging conventions within Haraka
- [Net_Utils](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Net_Utils.md): This module provides network utility functions.
- [Outbound Mail with Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Outbound.md): How to send outbound mail with Haraka
- [Plugins](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Plugins.md): Most aspects of receiving an email in Haraka are controlled by plugins. Mail cannot even be received unless at least a 'rcpt' and 'queue' plugin are
enabled.
- [Results](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Results.md): Add, log, retrieve, and share the results of plugin tests.
- [Transaction Object](https://haraka.github.io/raw/core/Transaction.md): An SMTP transaction is valid from MAIL FROM time until RSET or "final-dot".
- [Getting Started](https://haraka.github.io/raw/getting_started.md): Getting Started with Haraka
- [Plugins](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins.md): Plugins is a collection of plugins for Haraka that extend its functionality.
- [auth/auth_bridge - Authenticate users against an external service](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/auth/auth_bridge.md): Haraka auth/auth_bridge plugin - Authenticate users against an external service
- [auth/auth_proxy - Authenticate users against an external service](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/auth/auth_proxy.md): Haraka auth/auth_proxy plugin - Authenticate users against an external service
- [auth/auth_vpopmaild - Authenticate users against vpopmaild](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/auth/auth_vpopmaild.md): Haraka auth/auth_vpopmaild plugin - Authenticate users against vpopmaild
- [auth/flat_file - Authenticate users against a flat file](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/auth/flat_file.md): Haraka auth/flat_file plugin - Authenticate users against a flat file
- [block_me - Block Me plugin for Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/block_me.md): Haraka block_me plugin - Blocks mail from a specific IP address
- [data.signatures - Signatures plugin for Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/plugins/data.signatures): Haraka data.signatures plugin - Signatures
- [delay_deny - Connection Delays plugin for Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/delay_deny.md): Haraka delay_deny plugin - Connection Delays
- [prevent_credential_leaks - Prevent credential leaks plugin for Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/prevent_credential_leaks.md): Haraka prevent_credential_leaks plugin - Prevent credential leaks
- [process_title - Process title plugin for Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/process_title.md): Haraka process_title plugin - Set the process title
- [queue/deliver - Deliver mail to the local MTA](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/queue/deliver.md): Haraka queue/deliver plugin - Deliver mail to the local MTA
- [discard - Discard mail](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/queue/discard.md): Haraka discard plugin - Discard mail
- [queue/lmtp - Deliver mail to the local MTA](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/queue/lmtp.md): Haraka queue/lmtp plugin - Deliver mail to the local MTA
- [queue/qmail-queue - Deliver mail to the local MTA](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/queue/qmail-queue.md): Haraka queue/qmail-queue plugin - Deliver mail to the local MTA
- [quarantine - Quarantine mail](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/queue/quarantine.md): Haraka quarantine plugin - Quarantine mail
- [queue/smtp_bridge - Deliver mail to the local MTA](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/queue/smtp_bridge.md): Haraka queue/smtp_bridge plugin - Deliver mail to the local MTA
- [queue/smtp_forward - Forward mail to another SMTP server](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/queue/smtp_forward.md): Haraka queue/smtp_forward plugin - Forward mail to another SMTP server
- [queue/smtp_proxy - Deliver mail to the proxy MTA](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/queue/smtp_proxy.md): Haraka queue/smtp_proxy plugin - Deliver mail to the proxy MTA
- [rcpt_to.in_host_list - Check if recipient is in host_list](https://haraka.github.io/plugins/rcpt_to.in_host_list): Haraka rcpt_to.in_host_list plugin - Check if recipient is in host_list
- [record_envelope_addresses - Record envelope addresses](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/record_envelope_addresses.md): Haraka record_envelope_addresses plugin - Record envelope addresses
- [reseed_rng - Reseed the random number generator](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/reseed_rng.md): Haraka reseed_rng plugin - Reseed the random number generator
- [status - Status plugin](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/status.md): Haraka status plugin that allows you to view the status of your Haraka server
- [tarpit - Tarpit plugin](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/tarpit.md): Haraka tarpit plugin - Tarpit plugin
- [tls - TLS support for Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/tls.md): Haraka tls plugin - TLS support for Haraka
- [toobusy - Reject connections when the server is too busy](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/toobusy.md): Haraka toobusy plugin - Reject connections when the server is too busy
- [xclient - XCLIENT support for Haraka](https://haraka.github.io/raw/plugins/xclient.md): Haraka xclient plugin - XCLIENT support for Haraka
- [Migrating from Haraka v1.x to v2.x](https://haraka.github.io/raw/tutorials/migrating_from_v1_to_v2.md): Haraka v2.x contains two significant changes to the v1.x API related to
streams.
- [Configuring Haraka For Outbound Email](https://haraka.github.io/raw/tutorials/settingupoutbound.md): It is trivially easy to configure Haraka as an outbound email server. But
first there are external things you may want to sort out:
- [Writing Haraka Plugins](https://haraka.github.io/raw/tutorials/tutorial.md): Part of the joy of using Haraka as your main mail server is having a strong
plugin based system which means you control all aspects of how your mail is
processed, accepted, and delivered.
- [Known Users](https://haraka.github.io/raw/users.md): Large Scale Haraka Users

## Landing

Every page below is available as raw markdown.

- [Haraka SMTP Email Server](https://haraka.github.io/raw/index.md): Haraka is an open source SMTP server written in Node.js. Haraka is fast, scalable, and extensible.
